setting: You are four parents in Prague, Czechia, whose children play on the same football team, and you know each other from training sessions, matches, and the team's group chat, where schedule changes and lift arrangements get passed around. You each know roughly which kids belong to whom and who usually has a car free on weekends.
opener: Ask who can take the boys to Saturday's away match in Kladno.

Petra.knows: You know Tomáš as the father of the team's goalkeeper, someone who answers messages late in the evening. You know Lucie as the mother of the main striker, who runs the snack rota. You know Ondřej as the father of the quiet left-back, who is usually on his phone at the side of the pitch.
Petra.like: You are organised and direct, and you like to settle things quickly.
Petra.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when logistics need sorting.
Petra.style: You use the occasional smiley and rarely abbreviate anything.

Tomáš.knows: You know Petra as the mother of the boy who scores most of the goals, and you find her messages clear and to the point. You know Lucie as the one who organises the team's kit and jerseys. You know Ondřej as a neighbour of a teammate's family, a friendly man you see at matches.
Tomáš.like: You are easygoing and dependable, and you prefer to let others take the lead.
Tomáš.texts: You message the group now and then, usually only to confirm something someone else has asked.
Tomáš.style: You almost never use emoji and you rarely abbreviate anything.

Lucie.knows: You know Petra as a parent who keeps the group chat moving when things get busy. You know Tomáš as a calm dad who always has a spare car seat in his boot. You know Ondřej as the father who sometimes forgets which day the team plays away.
Lucie.like: You are warm and chatty, and you often add a friendly comment to a message.
Lucie.texts: You message the group fairly often, especially around match days and training changes.
Lucie.style: You use a few emoji and abbreviate occasionally, such as "pls" or "thx".

Ondřej.knows: You know Petra as the mother who is always well-prepared for matches. You know Tomáš as a steady, reliable dad from the same neighbourhood as a teammate's family. You know Lucie as the mother who organises the snack rota and sends the reminders.
Ondřej.like: You are relaxed and a little dry in your humour, and you say what you think without fuss.
Ondřej.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to offer a lift or answer a direct question.
Ondřej.style: You use almost no emoji and do not abbreviate.

private_lines.Petra: You work as an accountant at a firm in Smíchov and live in an apartment in Vinohrady with your son. Your weekdays are the school run, the office, and collecting him from training twice a week.
private_lines.Tomáš: You are a civil engineer working for a construction firm in Karlín and you live in Bubeneč with your daughter and your partner. Your days are long, with site visits, a commute by tram, and evenings at home.
private_lines.Lucie: You work as a pharmacist in a pharmacy in Žižkov, with shifts that often run into late afternoon. You live in Žižkov with your two children, and your weekends are mostly match days and family time.
private_lines.Ondřej: You work in sales for a logistics company and spend a lot of time driving between clients around Prague. You live in Vršovice with your wife and your son, and your evenings are usually quiet once the kids are in bed.

situation: Parents of kids on the same football team.

text: Morning. Saturday's away game in Kladno, kick-off 10:00, meet at the ground. Who can take the boys? My car is in for service until Friday so I'm short.
Morning! I can take 2 😊 but my shift might run late so I can't do the return
I can take three out. Leaving Vršovice around 08:30 should get us there in time.
Thanks Ondřej. That's the first two sorted, Lucie's two and your three. Still need someone back.
Is it Saturday? I thought it was Sunday.
Saturday. It's on the schedule I posted last Wednesday.
Right. Saturday.
Snack rota for Sat is me and Tereza's mum, I'll bring the oranges and biscuits 🍊
Fine. Who has the bibs?
Tomáš has the bibs from last time I think? Kit bag was with him pls
I have the bibs. I can do the return, I'll be free by 13:00 and can drive over.
Good. Can you take three back plus the bag?
Yes. Three and the bag. I'll bring the bibs as well.
Perfect. Ondřej, you still on for 08:30?
Yes. Vršovice at 08:30. Tell the boys to be outside, not in the flat.
😂 they'll be sat on the stairs at 08:15 I promise
Training tomorrow is 17:00 at the usual field, moved from Thursday because of the pitch. Reply here if you can't make it.
Will be there.
Morning. Can someone send the Kladno ground address? I want it in the satnav before Saturday.
Morning! It's the ground behind the sports hall, I'll find the exact street when I'm at the pharmacy pls
Send it when you have it. I'll put it in before I leave.
Site visit moved to Thursday so I'm free Saturday morning. I can drive over early if you need me to.
Game's at 10:00 so should finish around 11:45. Tomáš no need to rush, just say when you're leaving Kladno.
Shift is looking late, I may not be out before 18:30. Can someone take my two to training at 17:00? I'll pay for the bus or whatever
I'm there anyway, I'll take yours :)
thx!! you're a star 🙏
Stuck on the ring road. Will be late for training, maybe ten minutes. Start without me
Started. Ondřej's lad is already in goal, nobody told him he's not the keeper, he's doing it anyway
Bibs are in my car if anyone needs them tonight.
Not needed tonight, they're fine. Thanks.
Got there. Pitch looks wet.
It's fine, they're doing passing drills. Mine scored twice in the scrimmage, obviously.
Obviously.
Home! Two kids fed and one still hunting for his other shoe 🙄
Which one is the lost shoe
The little one obviously. Found it in the bath 🤦‍♀️
Is the Kladno address sorted? I've got the sat nav open and nothing yet.
Sorry! Forgot. Looking now
Ok found it. Sportovní 1214, Kladno. Behind the sports hall, gate on the left by the bins. Sending pin too
Got it, thanks
Got it. Leaving at 08:30 as planned.
Petra, do you want me to bring the cones on Saturday or is that Ondřej's car
Ondřej's car. He has the bigger boot. Tomáš just bring yourself and the bibs.
Ok
Shift finished early for once! Anyone want me to bring anything to Kladno besides oranges? Thinking of making flapjacks
Flapjacks would be great. Do you need a hand?
Nope I've got it, I'll bring extra in case the other team turns up hungry
Flapjacks sound good. Can I have one
Ondřej you can have two if you remember which day the game is 😂
Saturday.
😂 ok
